meta.title: There's a Number That Stops the Entire Stock Market
meta.hook: If the S&P 500 falls 7% in a day, the whole market stops trading.
meta.description: US exchanges use market-wide circuit breakers tied to the S&P 500's prior-day close: a 7% or 13% drop triggers at least a 15-minute halt (before 3:25pm), and a 20% drop shuts trading down for the rest of the day. These exact 7/13/20% thresholds have been in place since February 2013. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: If the S and P five hundred crashes seven percent in a single day, the entire US stock market stops trading, automatically.

visual.query: stock market crash red numbers screen
visual.visual_intent: A trading screen flooded with red falling numbers, tense high-contrast lighting
visual.decision_reason: hook beat: the dramatic stop-the-market fact

scenes.narration: That's not a glitch. It's a rule, called a market-wide circuit breaker.

visual.query: nyse trading floor exterior wide shot
visual.visual_intent: The New York Stock Exchange building facade, steady wide shot, neutral daylight
visual.decision_reason: grounds the rule in a real regulated institution

scenes.narration: There are three trigger levels, measured against the previous day's closing price: seven percent, thirteen percent, and twenty percent.

visual.query: financial chart three levels graphic screen
visual.visual_intent: Three tiered horizontal lines on a dark chart, each labeled with a percentage, minimal cinematic render
visual.decision_reason: SEC Rule 7.12 / NYSE MWCB, thresholds set Feb 2013

scenes.narration: Hit the first two levels before three twenty-five in the afternoon, and trading halts for at least fifteen minutes.

visual.visual_intent: A clock face or trading floor clock, static tension, cool light
visual.decision_reason: NYSE MWCB FAQ: Level 1/2 halt minimum 15 minutes, 9:30am-3:25pm window

scenes.narration: Hit the third level, twenty percent, and the market shuts down for the rest of the day, no matter what time it is.

visual.visual_intent: An empty, dimly lit trading floor, stillness after chaos, documentary tone
visual.decision_reason: Level 3 halts trading for remainder of session per NYSE MWCB rules

scenes.narration: These exact thresholds have only been in place since February twenty thirteen, when regulators replaced the old system with tighter triggers.

visual.visual_intent: An official regulatory document or seal, formal steady framing
visual.decision_reason: SEC approved 7/13/20% S&P 500-based thresholds effective Feb 4 2013, replacing prior 10/20/30% DJIA-based rule

scenes.narration: It's not there to stop losses. It's there to stop panic from feeding on itself. Follow for more.

visual.visual_intent: A calm shot of a city skyline through an office window, settling tone
